title: Vouch verification result, formats 1 and 2
description: What pof-verify returns for one .pof file: the WASM verify() result, `pof-verify check --json`, and the attestor's /v1/verify response. `envelope` is the JSON projection of the proof itself; hex strings are lowercase, amounts are zatoshi, times are unix seconds.

checks.description: The six checks, cheapest first. A check after the first failure is not-run.

envelope.description: The decoded proof, or null when the file did not parse.

checksum.description: blake2b-256 of the body, when the file got that far.

anchor.description: The published anchor record the proof matched, if any.

scope.description: The scope the proof's tags belong to: in format 2 blake2b of (circuit, audience, epoch), in format 1 the statement itself. Null when the file did not parse.

tags.description: The proof's five per-note tags. The same note gives the same tag inside one scope, so a verifier records them for a Valid verdict and passes them back as its reuse registry.

revealed.description: An exit certificate's revealed nullifiers (circuit 2, reveal = 1): a deposit it certifies may spend only these. Empty for any other proof.

now.description: The time the verdict was evaluated at.

verifier.description: Name and version of the verifier, e.g. "pof-verify 0.1.0".

claim.description: The one statement a proof asserts. v1 provers make HoldsAtLeast, in whole 0.125 ZEC units (12,500,000 zatoshi); the other kinds are reserved.

dormantSince.description: Present when the proof shows the notes unmoved since this earlier block.

oneOf.description: The spent set the proof was made against is older than the verifier's policy allows.
The notes are shown unmoved since a later block than the verifier's policy requires.
Made for this verifier, but in another period than the one it asked for (or a format 1 proof, which has no shared period).
A valid proof whose notes the verifier already accepted in the same period.

anchor.description: The two roots the proof was proved against and their blocks. height: the spent set (the block the proof is as of). ncHeight: the note-commitment tree; equal to height in format 1, earlier when the notes are shown unmoved since then.

ncRoot.description: Ironwood note-commitment tree root at ncHeight.

nfRoot.description: Spent-nullifier indexed Merkle tree root at height.

anchorRecord.description: An entry of the published anchor table (/api/anchors). blockHash is null for the demo ledger.

envelope.description: The JSON projection of a .pof file. The version comes from the file header; everything else is the body.

version.description: 1, or 2 with the circuit, the epoch and a second anchor height.

circuit.description: 1: the threshold circuit. 2: threshold plus revealed nullifiers (exit certificates). Always 1 in format 1.

epoch.description: The verifier's period. With the circuit and audience it fixes the scope: the same notes give the same tags inside one scope. Always 0 in format 1.

audience.description: blake2b-256 of "pof-audience:" + the verifier's identifier, trimmed and lowercased. Never the name.

binding.description: 32 bytes the proof is bound to (a Solana pubkey for on-chain audiences), all zero when unbound.

expiresAt.description: Exclusive: at this second the proof is already expired.

revocation.description: The proof id: the first 16 bytes of blake2b(secret). Publishing the secret revokes it.

publicInputs.description: Public inputs the verifier cannot derive (the rest it derives from the envelope).

proof.description: Halo2 proof bytes, at most 16 KiB.
